title: Playing Goldkette records: stock arrangements and slap bass
summary: Brown explains how the band adapted stock orchestrations, notes the last record, Venuti, Don Murray's clarinet parts, and his slap bass.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
